metadata.title: Diffuse Personal AI snapshot manifest
metadata.description: Source-first ETL manifest, default scenario, and consolidation contract for the immutable 26 August 2026 snapshot.

update.method: agent-assisted source-first ETL with deterministic consolidation and human review
update.notes: This file is the updating agent entry point. Create a new immutable snapshot, refresh one JSON file per source, consolidate both gates, validate, and publish.

gates.label: Gate 1 · Model–harness capability
gates.title: Gate 1 consolidated model–harness evidence
gates.description: Source-normalized evidence and model inputs for the model–harness capability gate and its supporting context.

gates.label: Gate 2 · Compute supply
gates.title: Gate 2 consolidated compute evidence
gates.description: Source-normalized evidence and model inputs for the U.S. inference-compute supply gate.

datasets.title: Model–harness economic capability benchmarks
datasets.description: Normalized benchmark catalog and release-quarter frontier observations used to estimate current economic capability and its failure-gap velocity.

calculation.preparation: Comparable model–harness results are normalized to bounded 0–1 completion scores, assigned to four economic-work categories, and confidence weighted.
calculation.countdownEffect: Sets the current capability composite and the benchmark-level failure gaps projected forward. Stronger scores move the capability crossing earlier.

update.notes: Append comparable release-quarter frontier observations. Preserve benchmark versions, normalization anchors, harness scope, and comparability notes.

datasets.title: METR task-completion horizons
datasets.description: H50 capability-velocity signal and H80 reliability guardrail used to estimate relative acceleration.

calculation.preparation: Published H50 and H80 task-completion horizons are aligned by model release and converted to task-horizon velocity and acceleration.
calculation.countdownEffect: H50 acceleration changes how quickly benchmark failure gaps close; H80 acts as a reliability guardrail. Higher positive acceleration moves the capability crossing earlier.

update.notes: Fetch the current METR benchmark-results artifact, append comparable H50 and H80 release observations, and refresh published velocity estimates without erasing prior snapshots.

datasets.title: AI adoption and product-release evidence
datasets.description: Comparable adoption series and release events retained as context and forecast diagnostics; these do not directly set the two-gate countdown.

calculation.preparation: Adoption observations retain their original population, cadence, and units; users, seats, downloads, subscriptions, and stars are never merged into one curve.
calculation.countdownEffect: Does not directly change either gate. It tests the conjecture that usable capability transmits into delegation and can weaken the forecast if adoption fails to follow.

update.notes: Append observations only when their population, cadence, and unit remain comparable. Do not convert downloads, revenue, seats, or subscriptions into active delegated users.

datasets.title: Research evidence ledger
datasets.description: Source-backed facts used in the conjecture, capability catalog, and contextual discussion but not necessarily in the live forecast equations.

calculation.preparation: Source-backed claims are preserved with caveats and comparability notes instead of being converted into synthetic scores.
calculation.countdownEffect: Does not directly move the date. It supports or challenges the assumptions, benchmark choices, and interpretation surrounding both gates.

update.notes: Refresh claims from primary sources, preserve caveats, and leave incomparable observations as separate records.

datasets.title: Personal-agent capability catalog
datasets.description: User-relevant capability stack, operational measures, maturity, and benchmark evidence for computer-use delegation.

calculation.preparation: User-relevant capabilities are mapped to observable measures, maturity judgments, and applicable benchmark families.
calculation.countdownEffect: Does not directly move the date. It reveals missing coverage and determines whether the benchmark basket represents real personal delegation well enough.

update.notes: Add capabilities only when they map to a user outcome and an observable operational measure. Refresh current-state assessments from benchmark evidence.

datasets.title: U.S. operational AI service capacity
datasets.description: Observed and dated projected U.S. AI IT power, inference productivity per IT GW-day, the resulting supported Personal-AI users, and independently sourced build-rate and allocation diagnostics.

calculation.preparation: Epoch's registry identifies U.S. sites; dated site states are summed as operational IT power. H100-equivalents remain a secondary bridge for estimating reference token-equivalents per IT GW-day. Physical power, productivity, inference allocation, Personal-AI allocation, and workload are then combined into supported-user equivalents.
calculation.countdownEffect: Converts physical IT power and inference productivity into supported Personal-AI users. The gate passes only when service capacity reaches 100% of the selected population target.

update.notes: Refresh Epoch's data-center registry and timeline together, recompute every quarter from the dated U.S. site states, and review productivity and allocation assumptions separately from physical power. Refresh independent build-rate and allocation outlooks as supporting evidence without merging global watts into the U.S. series.

etl.sourceResultContract: Every source file materializes an explicit results summary with status, countdown role, counts, and measurements. Missing numerical results are labeled rather than inferred.
workflow: Copy the latest snapshot to a new dated directory.
Fetch each URL named by every source file and update only that source file.
Normalize records to the existing fragment schema without rewriting earlier snapshots.
Run scripts/consolidate_snapshot.mjs to rebuild both gate files deterministically.
Validate identifiers, dates, units, provenance, record counts, and forecast invariants.
Rebuild the reports and site; both read only the latest consolidated gate files.
